summary: Basic product info block for Buy Box with title, brand, logo, and rating.
features: Brand logo with customizable format and background
Brand name with optional link to brand page
Rating display with variant and alignment options
shortDescription: The Basic Product Info block displays essential product identification at the top of the Buy Box. It combines the product title, brand name, brand logo, and aggregate rating into a cohesive header area. The brand elements can link to brand pages for cross-selling. Logo format adapts between mobile and desktop with optional background styling. Rating display offers multiple star color variants and layout orientations to match the page design.
